Good to know

Before you book

Do you charge for inspections and quotes?+

No — inspections and written quotes are completely free, with no obligation. Call (02) 4036 3901 or send the enquiry form below and we’ll arrange a time that suits.

I have a leak. How fast can you get here?+

We’re based on Glebe Rd in Merewether, so for local leaks we can usually inspect within a day or two — sooner for active leaks after storms. Call us and we’ll tell you honestly where you sit in the queue.

Restoration or full replacement — which do I need?+

If the roof structure and most tiles are sound, a restoration (clean, repair, re-bed, point and coat) usually adds 10–15 years of life for far less than a re-roof. If tiles are brittle throughout or the roof is metal and rusted through, replacement is the smarter spend. The inspection photos will make the call obvious.

How long does a restoration take?+

Most homes take 2–4 days depending on size and weather. You can stay in the house the whole time, and we confirm the schedule before we start.

Do you work on metal roofs as well as tile?+

Both. We repair and restore Colorbond and other metal roofing, replace rusted sheets and screws, and handle tile-to-metal conversions when a full re-roof makes sense.
